message_2_body:
Hi Vivek —

Thanks — we signed up this morning. The team is interested but there are a couple of constraints:
1) Our InfoSec prefers meetings in the 13:00–17:00 local window (EST) — mornings are tough.
2) We need at least one hour for a technical walkthrough with our CloudOps lead and InfoSec.
3) Before the demo, can you confirm whether Redwood provides:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 letter for hosted control plane vs. Private)
   - Data residency controls for on‑prem/VPC installs
   - KMS/HSM integration options and an example architecture diagram

If you can share a short checklist or evidence folder, that would help us prioritize attendees. Preference: Wed 2/24 14:00–15:15 EST if that can be extended to 75 minutes.

Regards,
Celine Park

cpark@medgov.org

message_3_headers:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Celine Park <cpark@medgov.org>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T13:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo for Private deployment — availability?
message_3_body:
Hi Celine —

Great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the constraints — we can absolutely do a 75-minute deep-dive. Proposed plan for the session:

- 0–10 min: Intros + scope (use cases, data classification)
- 10–40 min: Architecture walkthrough (VPC/private control plane, network boundaries, KMS/HSM options)
- 40–65 min: Live demo of deployment flow + admin console (tenant isolation, RBAC, tracing)
- 65–75 min: Q&A + next steps (evidence pack and procurement path)

We’ll attach a short evidence pack and an intake checklist ahead of the call. For your asks:
- SOC 2: We don’t ship a hosted SOC 2 for a customer-managed on‑prem control plane, but we can provide our SOC 2 report and a mapping document describing which controls are customer responsibilities vs. Redwood responsibilities.
- Data residency: on‑prem and VPC deployments keep customer data in your VPC/on‑prem network; we’ll show the network diagrams.
- KMS/HSM: we support Bring‑Your‑Own‑KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) and HSM flows via standard APIs — will include an example architecture.

Can we lock Wed 2027-02-24 14:00–15:15 EST? If that’s confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the two files: redwood-private-deploy-overview.pdf and medgov-intake-checklist.xlsx.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

— MedGov Security
